title: A Hundred Paces Through a Willow Leaf

source.book: Records of the Grand Historian, Annals of Zhou
source.quote: In Chu there was a man named Yang Youji, a master archer. A hundred paces from a willow leaf he shot at it, and in a hundred shots he hit it a hundred times.

moral: A hundred hits out of a hundred is not born — it is practised, arrow by arrow.
